name: Dental
title: Referral Partners for Dental Practices | Our Local Network
description: We visit the daycares, gyms and leasing offices near your dental practice in Elmhurst, Lombard and Downers Grove. You see every sign-up in your portal.
cardBlurb: We visit the daycares, gyms and leasing offices that see local families.
intro: We find businesses near your practice that see the same families you do. Every month we visit them and introduce your practice by name.
partnersIntro: Families and new neighbors pass through these places, and the staff know them.

partners.name: Daycares and preschools
partners.why: Parents of young kids want a dentist the whole family can see.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Members keep a routine and care about how they look and feel.

partners.name: Apartment leasing offices
partners.why: New residents need a dentist close to their new home.

partners.name: Kids' swim and dance schools
partners.why: Parents wait in the lobby every week, and the staff know every family.

partners.name: Hair salons and barbershops
partners.why: Neighbors of every age come in every few weeks and chat with staff.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Couples getting married are thinking about their smile in every photo.

treatsIntro: We bring coffee and treats for everyone on shift, from the front desk to the teachers.
treatExamples: Coffee and muffins for a daycare's opening staff
Snacks and cold drinks for a swim school's after-school instructors
Bagels and coffee for a leasing office's morning team
portalNote: Each sign-up lands in your portal, and your front desk makes the call, not us.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: You and each partner agree to promote each other. Nobody is paid per referral or per patient.

notes.title: No patient records, ever
notes.text: We never receive patient records, and partners never see who signed up. The sign-up form asks no health questions.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We make no medical or health claims. We describe your services only in words you approve.

exclusivity: Each partner agrees to promote one dental practice, yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Will you visit other dental practices near me?
faq.a: No. We only visit businesses that don't compete with you.

faq.q: What about the rules for healthcare practices?
faq.a: Partner programs for healthcare practices are reviewed for compliance with applicable state rules before launch. If your lawyer wants to read the partner agreement, we'll send it.

faq.q: Can we keep the relationships we already have?
faq.a: Yes. We skip businesses you already work with unless you ask, and those relationships stay yours.

aboutText: I'm asking about referral partners for my dental practice.
